messages:
toni: Hi all — opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/51499. Adds a cost-aware routing policy that can downgrade to a quantized model variant when per-tenant cost crosses a threshold. Also a small memory accounting tweak to per-request reservations and a KMS rotation metadata change. Need cross-team eyes: @samir (runtime), @lenora (infra), @maya (security). Targeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC merge window. Quick skim please :pray:

samir: Thanks — quick q: what's the p50/p99 delta on the hot path when downgrade is exercised? Also how tested?

toni: Good Q. Local perf + staging canary numbers I ran:
```
baseline (no downgrade): p50 18ms, p99 95ms
with downgrade enabled: p50 20ms, p99 108ms
throughput impact: ~3% lower at same concurrency (due to quantized-model switching cost)
```
Tested with staging traffic replay + synthetic spike.

lenora: Mem accounting change: you said "per-request reservation" — can that cause OOM under high concurrent inference? Need to see fail-open behavior and a rollout flag. Also pinging infra to check allocator interaction.

toni: Rollout plan: default off. Feature flag gate + canary (1% tenants) for 24h then 10% for 6h then full. If mem pressure observed we fallback to legacy accounting and disable downgrade. Example flag config: 
```yaml
feature_flags:
  cost_based_downgrade:
    enabled: false
    canary_pct: 1
    escalation_policy: revert_on_mem_spike
```
Also added a runtime knob `reservations.max_per_request` with sane defaults.

maya: For security: what changes to KMS usage? Any new permissions needed? Does rotation change secrets shape?

toni: Only metadata: we write a `key_rotation_id` tag to model-metadata bucket so we can correlate model slices to rotation. No new KMS keys, still using existing key IDs and the same Encrypt/Decrypt IAM role. Minimal IAM: `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.get` and `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.list` (read-only). No HSM changes.

infra-bot: CI: build ✅, unit tests ✅, integration tests ✅, e2e: flaky failure on staging-015 (timeout). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/51499/logs

cj: I can own the canary in us-east1 tomorrow morning. Will watch latency, mem, and error budgets.

ben: who signs infra + platform? lenora, samantha?

lenora: I can give a provisional +1 after canary runs and I see mem traces for the first 1h. Also please include a small tracing span around reservation+downgrade to make root cause easier.

samir: tiny code nit in the selector: factor kernel selector into a single exported function so platform can reuse it. Not blocking.

toni: Will send a follow-up patch for the selector factor and add the tracing span. Thanks for the quick reviews.

maya: I'll review IAM bits today. If CI e2e is flaky can we rerun after fixes?

toni: Yep — will fix the flaky test and push. Plan is: patch -> re-run CI -> canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC (cj owning). Please drop :+1: or LGTM if you can after you eyeball the diffs.

samir: 👍 can review again after the selector patch.

lenora: 👍 watching for mem traces.

ben: I'll be on-call during the window, ping me if we revert.

infra-bot: Merge readiness: awaiting 2 approvals (runtime, infra) and green e2e.

toni: tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra @eng-security for visibility. Thanks all!
